rows: Maintenance Procedures Information System (MPIS)
Generating Stations
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: Gov-012-r0a
Equipment: Mechanical speed governor
Status: Approved
Issued to: Esna Power Station
Document approval date: 26 November 2007
Procedure: Maintenance Record Data Sheet (MRDS)
Next review date: November 2012

This document is implemented in accordance with the overhaul and cleaning works on the mechanical speed governor, as per the station's major equipment outage programme. The first draft of the document was prepared and field-tested by Eng. Abd El-Salam Abd El-Hamid Metwally at Esna Power Station, reviewed by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, endorsed by Eng. Abd El-Karim Moussa Ahmed: Mechanical Maintenance Department Manager at the station, approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali: General Manager of Esna Power Station, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Osama Suleiman Selim: General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and MPIS Coordinator.
Issue an approved work permit; maintenance personnel must hold the occupational safety and health category card
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, e.g. wearing a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Make sure the work area is marked out and the appropriate warning signs are posted
Shut down the unit and put it in maintenance mode
Occupational safety and health and personal protective equipment (PPE)
Safety pin
Close the inlet and outlet gates
Dewater and dry the unit
Check the oil level in the return oil tank
Check the oil level and pressure value in the governor cylinder
Check the governor oil cooling circuit filter
Check the regulating group filter
Check the unloading valve of each pump
Check the safety valve of the oil circuit of each pump separately
Check the guide vane regulating group
Check the runner blade regulating group
